usa.headline: Chicago now has the worst traffic in the U.S. — here's why
usa.summary: Traffic is bad in many U.S. cities, but Chicago is the worst. Years of construction are causing record delays on the freeway between downtown and O'Hare Airport.

usa.headline: Medicare looks a bit different in 2027, so don't miss open enrollment
usa.summary: Open enrollment for Medicare runs through Dec. 7, and there are a few different pitfalls people should watch out for this year. Your drug plan or Medicare Advantage plan could be changing a lot.

usa.headline: He expected a small-business loan. He got a 7-year nightmare
usa.summary: America's fastest-growing source of funding for small businesses is also one of the least regulated. One man has waged a long, lonely fight to recoup its punishing cost.

usa.headline: Storms expected on both coasts threaten Thanksgiving travel
usa.summary: The mayor of San Francisco is asking people in the city not to travel unless "absolutely essential." Meanwhile, a storm moving up the Eastern seaboard could also cause travel delays ahead of Thanksgiving.

usa.headline: Federal jury convicts man of starting the deadly 2025 Palisades Fire in Los Angeles
usa.summary: Prosecutors argued the defendant, 30-year-old Jonathan Rinderknecht, had been "mad at everything" in the days leading up to the January 2025 fire, which killed 12 people.

usa.headline: Jury finds man guilty in retrial over devastating 2025 Palisades fire in Los Angeles
usa.summary: After a mistrial earlier in the year, a new jury has found the man accused of starting the devastating 2025 Palisades fire in Los Angeles guilty.
